correct_completion: she finished the report on time.
full_sentence: Although she was tired, she finished the report on time.
acceptable_variants: she still finished the report on time.

options.text: so she went to bed early.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' shows contrast, not result. 'So' would be used to show a result, not a contrast.

options.text: she was feeling tired all day.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of tiredness instead of giving the contrasting action expected after 'although'.

options.text: she finished the report on time.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason, which does not fit a sentence that begins with 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Polish speakers often confuse contrast connectors with cause connectors, so check whether the second part goes against expectation.
translation: Chociaż była zmęczona, skończyła raport na czas.
